request.raw_text: Design simple locking mechanism in the area of the hook to secure carried load.

aim.primary_aim: Provide a simple locking mechanism in the hook area that secures the carried load.

functional_design_intentions.name: Load retention
functional_design_intentions.description: Secure the carried load against unintended release from the hook.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: locking mechanism in the area of the hook

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: existing hook and all non-targeted model geometry
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the hook's load-carrying role and minimize changes to geometry not required for integrating the locking mechanism.

geometry.description: A simple locking mechanism exists in the area of the hook.

functions.name: Secure carried load
functions.description: The locking mechanism secures the carried load at the hook.

behaviors.name: Constrain unintended load release
behaviors.description: The locking mechanism constrains the carried load from unintentionally escaping the hook.

validation_criteria.description: A locking feature is present in the area of the hook.
The locking mechanism secures the carried load at the hook.
The final mechanism constrains unintended release of the carried load from the hook.
The hook retains its load-carrying role, and non-targeted model geometry remains unchanged except where necessary to integrate the locking mechanism.

unresolved_requirements.description: The locking mechanism type, exact placement, interfaces, dimensions, allowable motion, actuation method, and required load capacity are not specified.
The qualitative requirement "simple" does not define measurable limits on part count, motion, or complexity.
